# Simplified expenses or actual costs: which claim is bigger?

> Free UK simplified expenses calculator for sole traders: compare HMRC's 45p/25p mileage rate and £10/£18/£26 use-of-home flat rate with your actual costs and see which claim is bigger and what it saves in tax. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
